name: adspower-mcp-monorepo
description: Mission Control monorepo — FastAPI bridge (backend) + Next.js 15 operator UI (frontend) over the adspower_mcp Python package.

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv run uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8080 --host 127.0.0.1 || .venv/bin/uvicorn backend.main:app --reload --port 8080 --host 127.0.0.1)
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && (command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 && uv sync --extra dev || python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e .[dev])
